Belmore cafeteria fries.d: Cooked twice in hot oil until crisp, salted hard. White vinegar on every table.

Saltines, cheddar and pickles.d: Thick slabs of the sharp stuff, dill spears, a sleeve of crackers and hot English mustard.

3am open roast beef sandwich.d: Rare slices warmed in brown gravy on thick white toast, more gravy poured over. Buttered mashed potatoes and peas.
3am open roast beef sandwich.note: From the steam table, all night.

Peach brandy bread pudding.d: Buttered white loaf layered with brandied peaches, baked in vanilla custard. Served warm.

Cabbie's peach brandy coffee.d: Strong drip with a nip of peach brandy and brown sugar, a spoonful of soft whipped cream on top.
Cabbie's peach brandy coffee.note: Twelve hours on coffee is no way to drive.
